name: interface-design
description: Portable design skill behavior and routing checks

scenarios.name: unsettled web direction
scenarios.prompt: We are redesigning a research dashboard. The goal is to help a reader resume one saved paper and see its annotations. Direction is unsettled. Give the process and first review artifact only; do not edit files. Read `.claude/skills/interface-design/SKILL.md` and its relevant reference first.

judge: The response proposes three conceptually distinct visual boards with content, layout, type, color and fit or risk, and holds final implementation for a user direction choice. It reserves disposable first-screen renders for choices that need layout or motion proof.
The response treats real dashboard content, states, accessibility and responsive proof as required before completion. It makes no unsupported claim of having rendered the design.

scenarios.name: existing direction
scenarios.prompt: The user has selected a restrained editorial direction for a new web reading page. Explain the next implementation and verification steps only; do not edit files. Read `.claude/skills/interface-design/SKILL.md` first.

judge: The response accepts the supplied direction without asking for three new boards or another choice. It plans concrete content, reachable states, responsive, accessibility and rendered verification.
